title: Swiss VAT rate, one line

turns.content: What is the standard VAT rate in Switzerland? Keep it short.

rationale: Short factual question with a time-dependent answer: tests concise answers (1.3) with the right figure (1.2) and, ideally, a date reference.

provenance.summary: The standard VAT rate rose from 7.7% to 8.1% on 1 January 2024. Models trained earlier may still say 7.7%.

sources.title: Current Swiss VAT rates
sources.supports: The Federal Tax Administration states the normal rate is 8.1% (page updated 5 Nov 2026).

expected_behavior: Answers briefly: 8.1% (reduced rates exist), maybe with a note on the date. No long explanation of Swiss VAT (1.3). Using 7.7% is an accuracy failure (1.2).
reference_answer: The standard rate is 8.1% (as of 2026; it was raised from 7.7% on 1 January 2024). There are also reduced rates, for example 2.6% for many foodstuffs, and a special rate for accommodation. If you need the rate for a specific product or service, tell me what it is and I will check which rate applies.

rubric.criterion: Gives a date or vintage reference

key_facts.claim: The Swiss standard VAT rate is 8.1%.

review.notes: ESTV page confirms normal rate 8.1%, reduced 2.6%, special 3.8%.
